name: Konyo Konyo Market
subtitle: Konyo-Konyo is one of Juba's major markets and a distribution point for goods across South Sudan.

facts.label: Problems
facts.value: Congestion, waste, drainage and hygiene concerns

facts.label: Fire
facts.value: A fire in December 2024 destroyed about 56 shops (per Radio Tamazuj)

facts.label: Redevelopment proposal
facts.value: A developer proposes about 800 shopping spaces

parts.text: Konyo-Konyo is one of Juba's major markets and a distribution point for goods across South Sudan. It has faced congestion, fires and redevelopment proposals.
